Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
Absolutely — here’s a simple place to start with your new Alen:
Take the purifier out of the box and remove all protective films. The filter is already inside the unit, so open the front panel and unwrap it.
Place your Alen along the room’s longest wall, at least 18 inches away from furniture.
Plug it in and press the power button. For best results, leave it running 24/7.
Register your purifier using its serial number and purchase information to activate the Forever Guarantee. You’ll need proof of purchase and an active filter subscription or proof of a recent filter purchase every 12 months, or every 15 months for the BreatheSmart 75i.
Consider setting up a filter subscription for replacement filters, free shipping, and 10% off each filter.
Connect your purifier to Wi-Fi using the Alen Air app to control it remotely, monitor air quality, and receive filter-replacement notifications.
You can begin at alen.com.

Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
Absolutely. The main choices come down to room size and what you want the filter to address.
Purifier size
BreatheSmart 25i: Best for bedrooms, nurseries, and dorms; up to 800 square feet.
BreatheSmart 35i: A good value for bedrooms, home offices, and smaller spaces; up to 1,400 square feet.
BreatheSmart 45i: Designed for larger bedrooms, living rooms, and medium open spaces; up to 1,900 square feet.
BreatheSmart 75i: Best for large open living areas and kitchens; up to 2,800 square feet.
All four models offer Wi-Fi, automatic speed adjustment, and a color-changing air-quality ring. The 75i and 45i also include an ionizer.
Filter type
Essential: The basic option for dust, allergens, and airborne particles.
Advanced: Adds carbon filtration for light smoke, chemicals, and everyday odors.
Ultimate: The strongest odor-focused option for pets, cooking, bathroom odors, smoke, and broader household pollutants.
As a simple rule: choose the purifier based on your room size, then choose Essential for particles, Advanced for some smoke or chemicals, or Ultimate when odors are a major concern. You can also use the purifier comparison page to compare models.
